Bij een kmo doe je alles een beetje, en dat maakt het net boeiend. Vandaag maak je een bestaand netwerk sneller en veiliger. Morgen zet je een volledig nieuwe omgeving op bij een klant die groeit. En tussendoor help je een zaakvoerder die dringend weer aan de slag moet. Concreet: Je bouwt, beheert en verbetert netwerken, servers en werkplekken bij onze klanten. Je zorgt voor een goede beveiliging met firewalls, VPN, back-ups en updates. Je ondersteunt klanten met Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune en andere cloudoplossingen. Je lost moeilijke problemen op en zoekt een oplossing die blijft werken, niet alleen een snelle fix. Je volgt systemen op afstand op en grijpt in voor de klant iets merkt. Je werkt projecten uit van begin tot einde: analyse, uitvoering en opvolging achteraf. Je bent het vaste aanspreekpunt voor je klanten voor projecten, voor de support kan je klant terugvallen op onze helpdesk. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar je staat er nooit alleen voor. Je team staat altijd klaar om mee te denken. Wie zoeken we? Iemand uit de ruime regio rond Sint-Niklaas Een teamplayer met het nodige gevoel voor humor Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als system engineer of IT-consultant binnen kmo omgevingen. Je kent netwerken goed: routing, switching, VLAN’s, firewalls, WiFi. Je werkt vlot met Windows Server, Active Directory en Microsoft 365. Je hebt ervaring met virtualisatie (Hyper-V en/of VMware). Je weet hoe je een IT-omgeving veilig houdt en bent op de hoogte van de huidige cybersecurity noden. Je legt technische zaken uit in gewone taal, zodat een klant je begrijpt. Je spreekt vlot Nederlands en Engels, Frans is een plus. Je neemt initiatief, hebt verantwoordelijkheidszin, werkt nauwkeurig en bent trots op goed werk. Kennis hebben van Google Workspace en of Azure is een plus. Een goede kennis hebben van Copilot, Chatgpt en Claude is een plus Een achtergrond of een goede programmeer kennis hebben is een plus Sociaal zijn en en graag communiceren met je collega´s en klanten. Je hebt een rijbewijs B. Wat bieden we jou? Bij Psystems kom je in een team dat groeit, maar klein genoeg blijft om iedereen goed te kennen. We zijn sterk in techniek, maar we vinden het persoonlijke contact met onze klanten en onderling minstens even belangrijk. Dit mag je van ons verwachten: Werk dat nooit saai wordt. Elke klant is anders, en je werkt aan projecten die er echt toe doen. Vertrouwen. Je plant je werk en afspraken zelf en je krijgt de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Collega’s die je snel verder helpen. Een vrolijk team waar veel gelachen kan worden. Kansen om bij te leren, met opleidingen en certificeringen die we samen kiezen. Een plek waar je ideeën gehoord worden. Zie je iets dat beter kan? Dan horen we het graag, de producten die we aanbieden worden telkens in teamoverleg beslist. Een vast contract, voltijds. Klanten in je eigen regio. Dus minder tijd in de file.

review_candidates.title: Network Engineer – Secure Network & Resiliency Operations
review_candidates.description: Vibrint transforms national security missions through advanced technology, data, and responsible intelligence solutions. Our teams design, secure, deploy, and sustain critical capabilities that enable faster, more informed mission decisions across some of the nation's most complex operational environments. By joining this prime contract, you'll help modernize and support secure systems, networks, laboratories, and fielded infrastructure serving mission users at customer and remote locations. As a Network Engineer in San Antonio, Texas, you will provide hands-on support for EHSC resiliency systems while collaborating with a Maryland-based team supporting two operational customers. You will configure and sustain Cisco and Arista devices, support firewalls and cryptographic equipment, troubleshoot hardware and connectivity issues, and maintain security compliance. You'll combine independent, on-site technical work with collaboration across a geographically distributed team, with occasional travel to Maryland. You'll also end your day knowing that you're doing work that truly matters. Position requires an active TS/SCI clearance with a Full Scope Polygraph (FSP). Responsibilities Configure, administer, and sustain Cisco and Arista network infrastructure. Provide hands-on support for EHSC resiliency systems in Texas, as directed by the appropriate EHSC teams. Support network operations, including firewall and cryptographic equipment, for systems in Texas, Maryland, and remote locations worldwide. Troubleshoot network hardware and physical connectivity issues, replacing equipment as needed. Rack, stack, and cable network equipment, servers, and peripherals. Support STE/STN requirements and System Security Plan (SSP) compliance for network devices. Work Jira tickets for operational requests, troubleshooting, maintenance, and hardware support. Coordinate with two civilian leads and seven contractors based in Maryland to prioritize and complete assigned work. Maintain regular communication with the broader team while managing local support tasks independently. Travel occasionally to Maryland to support program needs. Qualifications Significant hands-on experience configuring and sustaining Cisco and Arista network devices. Experience supporting network infrastructure, firewalls, and cryptographic equipment. Experience installing, racking, stacking, and cabling network equipment, servers, and peripherals. Experience troubleshooting hardware and physical connectivity issues. Familiarity with LatteArt and experience supporting STE/STN and SSP compliance for network devices. Ability to work independently on-site while collaborating remotely with a geographically distributed team. Current IAT Level I certification. Active TS/SCI clearance with a Full Scope Polygraph (FSP). U.S. citizenship. Willingness to travel occasionally to Maryland. Candidates must meet one of the following education and experience combinations: Twelve (12) years of network engineering experience without a degree; A bachelor's degree in a related technical discipline, plus eight (8) years of network engineering experience; or A master's degree in a related technical discipline, plus six (6) years of network engineering experience. Desired Skills Cisco Call Manager experience. Cisco ASA firewall experience. Experience automating repetitive tasks, inventory collection, and compliance activities. Experience working with cloud environments, hyperconverged infrastructure, and containerized environments. Strong communication skills and the ability to coordinate across technical teams. ___________________________________________________________________ The pay range for this position is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Our approach to crafting offers considers various factors to provide an equitable and competitive comprehensive compensation package. These considerations include, but are not limited to, contracted rates, education, certification(s), experience, specific competencies required for this position, and geographic location. Vibrint's comprehensive compensation package includes but is not limited to: competitive salary; annual merit-based salary increase and discretionary bonus program; 401(k) plan with a company maximum 9% contribution; 11 paid federal holidays; 160 hours of paid time off; medical, dental, vision, life and short- & long-term disability insurance; employee assistance program; and a generous professional development allowance. Equal Opportunity Employer All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, family structure, marital status, disability, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by law in all phases of the employment process and in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations. review_candidates.title: Network Engineer 24/7 Support
review_candidates.description: Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Columbia, Maryland, Synergy ECP is a leading provider of cybersecurity, software and systems engineering and IT services to the U.S. intelligence and defense communities. The company leverages its expertise in data transport solutions, software and systems engineering, and other solutions to deliver critical and innovative capabilities to high-level decision makers that enhance our nation’s security. In an ultra-competitive environment, Synergy ECP has thrived by adhering to our name, making sure excellence is displayed by our Employees, to our Customers and by Improving Performance (ECP). It’s what sets us apart, enabling us to be an autonomous yet agile business that delivers huge results—showing we’re ready to meet our customers’ evolving demands. Synergy ECP has earned a client list that includes numerous Fortune 100 companies, in addition to multiple branches of the US government and military services. This is a mission-critical opportunity supporting operations that run 24/7, 365 days a year . Our team ensures that essential systems stay online, secure, and performing at all times—and that includes overnight. We’re seeking an experienced Level 3 Network Engineer who is willing to step into a non-standard shift (including nights) to help keep this mission moving without interruption. This isn’t just another engineering role—this is the work that keeps everything else running. If you’re someone who thrives in high-responsibility environments and understands the importance of always-on operations, this is your chance to make a real impact. (24x7) Shift. Responsibilities Provide assistance in all aspects of network management, from network design through implementation, maintenance, and upgrading of existing networks. Analyze design, specifications, and related documents. Implement communication system requirements to support the distributed functionality of a software engineering environment. Analyze network characteristics (e.g., traffic connect time, transmission speeds, packet sizes, and throughput). Troubleshoot problems and recommend procurement of and/or modifications to network components. Level 3 Network Engineer Capabilities Design solutions, integrate, configure, deploy, test, and provide support for numerous types of network devices, interfaces, and methodologies. Optimize end-to-end system performance and dataflow management. Configure and optimize the network to connect various front-end and back-end components. Coordinate with system engineering and dataflow teams to ensure proper mission operations with minimal downtime. Facilitate the implementation of high-speed, scalable, fault-tolerant network topologies applicable to WAN and LAN design. Implement specific network solutions to support server requirements, including load balancing, VPNs, firewall contexts, and network address translation (NAT). Minimize network latency and maximize data throughput through design analysis and network performance monitoring tools. Lead large efforts involving dynamic requirements and scaling. Work with system engineers and cross-organizational teams to define requirements. Resolve complex network problems; operate network analyzers, WAN test equipment, and network simulators. Qualifications Twelve (12) years of experience in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity is required. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from an accredited college or university is required. Four (4) years of additional network engineering experience may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree. Five (5) years of experience with the following Network Tools: WhatsUp Gold and NetFlow. Five (5) years of experience with the following SIGINT Tools: Common View/Max View, Triton, and TUMMS. Additional Contract Or Position-Specific Required Experience Computer Network Operations Information Technology SIGINT CLEARANCE REQUIRED: TS/SCI w/ Polygraph Other Requirements: U.S. Citizenship Compensation Spotlight: For this role, our typical salary range starts at $200,000 and stretches up to $250,000. But here's the deal – we're not about capping your potential. We're committed to snapping up the best and brightest, and we're ready to put our money where our mouth is. So, if you're one of the rare exceptions to the status quo with the education, experience, and that extra something special, we're not afraid to go above and beyond to secure your talent. Because for us, it's not just about a salary. It's about the complete rewards package, the culture, and the opportunity to make a real impact. Taking Care of the People Who Take Care of The Nation Compensation: We offer highly competitive compensation that is consistently recognized by our employees as being generous! Health & Retirement: We offer a comprehensive Health Benefits package and 401K Retirement plan so you can take care of yourself and your family... both now and in the future. Other health-related benefits include People Partners who will help you navigate both personal and professional worlds, as well as strong wellness related resources offered through our healthcare provider. Education: Individual growth is a priority at Synergy ECP. Employees are encouraged to take advantage of our company-sponsored continuing education program so they can get their degree or that next certification needed to propel them towards the next level. Not sure what's best for your career plans, we'll help you navigate it all! Work/Life Balance: A healthy work/life balance is essential for building and executing your work effectively at Synergy ECP, but it’s also necessary to allow you the room to pursue everything you want to develop in your personal life. We offer a generous Paid Time Off benefit and 11 paid holidays a year. Synergy ECP also provides flexible work options that work with your schedule and lifestyle. Philanthropy: With the help of our amazing employees, Synergy ECP participates annually in building awareness, volunteering and contributing to dozens of organizations. We believe that giving back creates a sense of purpose, engagement, and fulfillment. Have a cause you are passionate about? We bet you'll find others here that care about it just as much! Great Corporate Facilities: Come by our corporate office and enjoy a weekly happy hour, take a drive to nearby restaurants, grab a snack or coffee in our café, or utilize our collaborative office space and conference rooms. SkillBridge: Our SkillBridge Program takes the incredible experience our servicemembers already have and shows them how to apply it within corporate environments. We are fanatical about helping our Military! Synergy ECP is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, age, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and are dedicated to maintaining a professional and respectful workplace where every employee can succeed.
